title: VirtualDesktop screen capture makes dropdowns invisible and/or unclickable
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot 4.0 up to the current 4.7.2, both versions are affected
- Seen only in Windows 11 with VirtualDesktop while using a Quest 3

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8180) - AMD Ryzen 9 7950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 63.21 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

- Not tried in Godot versions previous to 4.0 but my guess is that it happens in all versions using the same interface back-end

There isn't much to it. Godot's editor's drop-downs become unclickable. Sometimes you can't even drop them down. But when they do drop down the clicks are not registered.

Workaround is to use keyboard navigation when the drop-down allows it. Trying to expand the drop-down with control+x or space or control+space can sometimes make the drop down render but they are still unclickable. Another workaround is to use a pointing device connected to the computer directly, those will still work.

What is seen in the visor is the same thing that is seen in the display

If the drop-down is shown the actual mouse can click on it - to be very clear the real and directly connected pointer device still works, only the virtualdesktop pointer does not work on those specific elements, so it could be something in the way VD passes or sends click events that is only ignored by the drop-down. Please know that VD runs as admin and can click on everything else, even UAC dialogs.

I decided to raise this ticket here first because it is the one thing that does not respond to VD's implementation of a remote control, based on the rule of uniqueness there might be something unique about the control that causes this behavior or it would be more common place on other apps. 
It may have to do with the way VD passes the click to the elements in the desktop, but still very odd that only the drop-downs ignore it.



### Steps to reproduce

Connect to your PC using VirtualDesktop
Open or create a godot project
Navigate to the properties tab
Click on any property that has a drop-down
Try selecting anything in that drop-down

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

None specifically needed
